headline: Review of proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy, Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy, and Section J and K policy recommendations.
summary: The subcommittee will review and vote on a proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy, review a proposed Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy, and review and vote on recommended changes to Section J and Section K policies.
items: Review and approval of proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy
Review of proposed Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy
Review and approval of recommendations for Section J, including Section J with changes
Review and approval of recommendations for Section K, including Section K with changes
